top_level_directories.coworker/: Python backend — agent engine, providers, connectors, MCP, memory, automations, personas, server
top_level_directories.surfaces/: Frontend surfaces — surfaces/gui is the Tauri+React desktop app
top_level_directories.packaging/: Installer builds (macOS DMG, Windows PS1), auto-update manifest, dev bootstrap
top_level_directories.docs/: Design specs, decision logs, config.example.toml, how-it-works.png

directory_groups.coworker/connectors/: 28 files, ~12.7k LOC — integration adapters (Slack/GitHub/Gmail/Gcal/HubSpot/Trello/MCP), descriptors, gateway, senders, relay_client
directory_groups.coworker/providers/: 9 files, ~2.5k LOC — provider clients (OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini), router, registry, capabilities, matrix, errors
directory_groups.coworker/mcp/: 5 files, ~620 LOC — MCP client (stdio+streamable-http), oauth, config
directory_groups.coworker/memory/: 4 files, ~260 LOC — SQLite memory store + tools
directory_groups.coworker/automation/: 5 files, ~780 LOC — scheduler, store, models, tools (cron-based recurring runs)
directory_groups.coworker/personas/: 5 files, ~770 LOC — persona manifest (YAML frontmatter), registry, builtin/ops.md
directory_groups.coworker/testing/fake_slack/: test harness for Slack adapter (drives real handler)
directory_groups.surfaces/gui/: Tauri+React+Vite — src/components (50+ .tsx), src-tauri (Rust shell), e2e (Playwright, 60+ specs), e2e-live/

module_organization: Layered: cli/server (entry) → engine+agent (loop) → providers (LLM) / tools (local) / connectors (SaaS) / mcp (external) — with personas/memory/automation/permissions as cross-cutting concerns
